articles.summary: One group of researchers is bringing deep learning and innovative multiview scanning to that workhorse of bioimaging: confocal microscopy.
articles.title: Triple Threat: AI-assisted Multiview Confocal Imaging

articles.summary: Like the carefully timed and delicately executed notes of a piano piece, faculties of the brain such as perception and memory are achieved through the patterned firing of ensembles of neurons. Today's article discusses how holographic optogenetics aims to recreate that pattern. #optogenetics #CaImaging #holography
articles.title: Playing the brain's music back to itself with holographic optogenetics
